setup: One stationary 1280x720 RGB-D camera, RTX 5090, SAM3 resolution 504, UFM, FLASH camera-only worker. Objects were added in place: green ring, mini gamepad, yellow block. No robot motion.
measurement: Polling distinct completed frame IDs for 10-12 seconds per stage. Medians are per processed frame. Worker total_ms stops before JPEG/JSON snapshot publication; processed_fps is 1000/total_ms, not an end-to-end UI frame rate.
limits: One scene and short windows. Accepted candidates passed engineering gates, not independent pose ground truth. The memory values are one snapshot, not peaks or a multi-object OOM bound. Object size, texture, motion, occlusion, reseeding, and model load can change costs.
